jobs.prompt: Create ONE photorealistic cinematic movie still in horizontal 16:9, no collage or contact sheet. Reference 1 establishes the exact fictional 15-year-old girl Luna: preserve her youthful face, brown skin, strong brows, brown eyes, dark curly hair tied in a low loose ponytail, oversized charcoal cotton tee, olive cargo trousers. No tattoos or orange accessories. Reference 2 establishes the inherited black canvas Converse high-top pair: same flat ivory rubber soles, ivory toe caps, cream laces, silver eyelets, dark canvas, believable moderate wear and small cream repair on OUTER RIGHT shoe just above rubber edge. Realistic adult size that fits her, not giant shoes. Circular ankle patches belong ONLY to inner ankles. Reference 3 establishes the exact D06 attic: rear red brick gable, left casement window, timber roof rafters, open wooden trunk at left, upright round wooden stool beside trunk, rear workbench with lamp and cases, large right timber post, wide pale pine floorboards. Preserve that architecture and arrangement. Diffuse cool-neutral overcast daylight from existing left window, gently warm natural wood, tactile skin and fabric, understated 35mm cinematic photography. No sci-fi effects, no magical glow, no invented text or captions, no extra people or footwear. Medium-wide 35mm view, Luna sits on the upright stool next to the open trunk, quiet grief and curiosity on her downturned face. Her LEFT foot already wears the left inherited black high-top and rests on floor; her RIGHT foot is in a plain pale grey sock. She holds the matching RIGHT shoe gently in both hands at lap level, fully visible and loosened ready to put on. Exactly TWO shoes total: one worn, one held; no shoes in the trunk or elsewhere. A small folded cream funeral programme showing ONLY the older grandfather portrait from reference 4, with no words, rests on the trunk's front rim. A small monochrome teenage portrait from reference 5 lies inside the trunk and is secondary. Plain black uncapped marker on the right edge of trunk. Her scuffed wooden skateboard with black grip and natural pale wheels leans against the wall between trunk and rear workbench. Frame her whole head and both feet clearly, with chest and pair visibly related. Quiet sincere performance, mouth closed, not dramatic crying. These portraits are flat paper props, no other live people.

qa.reasonForCorrection: Wrong shoe/sock laterality and invented tiny funeral-program lettering; programme placed on floor.

Two shoes, readable outer-right repair, no outer ankle badge.

jobs.prompt: Precise limited correction of reference 1, this exact photographic movie still. Preserve Luna's face, dark low ponytail, charcoal tee, olive cargo pants, seated posture, hands and the same shoe held in her hands, the same camera composition, D06 attic and lighting, chest and skateboard. Correct the footwear on her feet: her anatomical LEFT foot, appearing on the RIGHT side of the frame nearest the stool's right leg, must wear the inherited black high-top; her anatomical RIGHT foot on the LEFT side of the frame must be in the plain pale-grey sock. Thus exactly two shoes total: one on her left foot and its matching right shoe in her hands. Do NOT alter the held shoe or add another. Move the folded grandfather funeral programme from the FLOOR onto the front rim of the trunk, leaning against the open lid; keep the small monochrome young portrait in its place. Replace the small funeral-program portrait with the exact silver-curly-haired older man with grey moustache from reference 2. Remove ALL WORDS and all lettering from this programme so it has only that small portrait on blank cream card. This is a physical paper prop, not an extra person. Do not change any other object, pose, camera or furniture. Natural photographic realism, no overlay labels.

qa.acceptedAs: Starter discovery frame; continuity details remain before final footage
strengths: Luna face and original wardrobe retained.
D06 geometry and quiet diffuse light retained.
Exactly two shoes: one worn and one held; restrained expression.
limitations: Requested anatomical left/right footwear swap did not apply: camera-left foot still wears the shoe and camera-right foot is socked. Adapt insertion action or correct before final sequence.
Funeral programme remains on the floor by trunk instead of rim.
Small teenage photo disappeared in correction; its reintroduction needs consistent placement if required by script.
Skateboard grip rendering differs slightly from K06; lock board master before movement.

jobs.prompt: Precise limited correction of reference 1, this exact photographic ending still. Preserve Luna's exact face, hair, private smile, body pose, hands, skateboard, composition, all attic architecture, furniture and lighting. Raise ONLY the trouser hems by about eight centimeters so the ankle-high black canvas sneaker collars are unmistakably visible on both feet, with cream eyelets/laces and a small area of upper tongue exposed. She wears the same inherited black HIGH-TOP Converse as product reference 2, not low sneakers; preserve natural foot size and complete grounded soles. Move the folded grandfather funeral programme from the stool onto the FRONT RIM OF THE TRUNK, leaning against the open lid beside the young monochrome portrait. The programme must show ONLY the exact older silver-curly-haired grandfather portrait from reference 3 and BLANK cream paper, remove ALL WORDS and lettering. Replace the monochrome young portrait propped against the inside trunk lid with a small black-and-white portrait of the teenage boy in reference 4, same young face and white vest. These are small paper photos, not additional people. Leave the now-empty wooden stool upright and unchanged in position. Keep everything else exactly as in reference 1. No titles, no invented initials, no text overlays.

qa.acceptedAs: Starter ending frame; product and prop continuity need final pass
strengths: Luna face and softened smile retained.
High-top collars now visible above slightly rolled trouser hems.
D06 composition, room anchors and skateboard retained.
Invented programme lettering removed; good quiet room area for later signature.
limitations: Funeral programme remains on the stool instead of trunk rim; younger portrait remains an approximate generated face.

Raised trouser cuffs differ from K01/K02; final wardrobe continuity needs one chosen hem length.
No initials added; intended for compositing later.
